dct_description_sm: These data were produced as part of a study investigating the effects various biotic and abiotic properties on tree seedling germination beyond existing geographic ranges. Engelmann spruce seeds were grown in a seed addition experiment at four study areas in the Canadian Rocky Mountains.

dct_title_s: Site information, seedling counts, and microclimate data for: Limited prospects for future alpine treeline advance in the Canadian Rocky Mountains
